global: This vibrant spicy ramen boasts a rich, reddish broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp nori, and chopped green onions. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows rich brown grain patterns and natural texture with visible wood fibers and subtle knots.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Japanese characters on its exterior surface.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and toppings, rich orange-red, glossy surface, swirling strands visible.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slight discoloration at its tip.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, irregularly shaped, with a slightly glossy surface and visible texture.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, glistening slice with golden-brown sear, showing marbled fat and soft, cooked meat texture.
